text:
maria: quick heads-up — aiming to publish py & ts SDKs in the 02:00 UTC change window tonight. I still need final wording for the deprecation blurb and the dist-tag plan.
cheng: copypasta of the release notes pls so I can stage the docs. are we doing 'latest' or 'next' for TS?
sam: i'd vote 'next' for the initial canary then flip to 'latest' on GA. but if we have signing drift we might hold.
anya: found a signer mismatch on one of the TS wheels in the staging artifact set — checksum vs CI-signed artifact. flagging now.
deploy-bot: publish blocked — signature mismatch for package @redwood/sdk-typescript 1.4.3. checksum: 0x9a3f... expected 0x7b2c... CI: release-pipeline-7 failed step: artifact-verify.
maria: ugh. thanks @anya and @deploy-bot. do NOT bypass verification. sam, can you triage the signer issue? if it's a transient CI key rotation we can still publish py tonight.
sam: looking. quick triage: the TS build used an older release-lambda runner that doesn't have the current GPG key. will try re-run with new runner. ETA 15m.
jordan: if TS still fails, propose: publish Python SDK now with a pinned compat shim in release notes, and hold TS under 'next' until we get a clean signed artifact. we should include rollback instructions in the notes.
maria: approve that plan unless sigs are fixed. docs: add a "Temporary pinning" section explaining users can pin to 1.4.2 for stability, and that 1.4.3 TS will follow. also add the deprecation note for legacy sync client (reminder: sunset date 2026-07-01).
cheng: drafting notes now. sample text: "The TypeScript package 1.4.3 is currently held due to artifact-signing verification. Python package 1.4.3 is published. If you rely on the legacy sync client, pin to @redwood/sdk-sync@0.9.x — see migration guide." ok?
maria: perfect. leave the wording conservative — don't promise ETA. add rollback commands we can run from release runbook.
sam: re-run complete — signature verified locally. CI pipeline still reporting failure due to cached verifier image. pushing a patch to pipeline now to pick up new verifier.
deploy-bot: re-run result: artifact-verify step now SUCCESS for @redwood/sdk-typescript 1.4.3.
anya: can someone sanity-check the tarball contents? found an extra README.tmp in the TS package that slipped in from CI worker.
jordan: remove the tmp file and republish, otherwise we risk docs confusion. it's a small fix.
maria: agreed. hold final flip. sam — can you publish a repackaged TS artifact once the tmp's removed? when published, use "next" dist-tag and don't flip to latest until we verify downloads for 30m.
sam: will do. commands i'll run: ```npm pack && tar -tf package.tgz | grep -v 'README.tmp' && npm publish --tag next && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.3 next``` then we'll smoke test.
cheng: docs will mention: "TS published under 'next' on 02:30 UTC; monitor downloads and errors for 30m. If no regressions, we will promote to 'latest' and update release notes." 
maria: contingency plan in case of rollback: include commands to yank the dist-tag and repoint to prior release: ```npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.2 latest && pip index versions redwood-sdk (or delete problematic wheel from repo)``` add the note to the runbook.
jordan: also add a short customer-facing blurb for the status page in case we hold TS longer than 2 hours. keep it factual.
anya: done — added a short incident-style note and the migration/pin guidance in docs.
sam: publishing TS repack now. npm publish done with tag 'next'. smoke tests: basic import + build in CI preview passed.
deploy-bot: package-publish event: @redwood/sdk-typescript 1.4.3 published with tag 'next' by sam.
maria: outstanding: wait 30m. if clean, i'll approve the flip to latest and update the release notes. thanks everyone for fast turnaround. :heart:
cheng: will follow up with PR to docs and include the deprecation blurb. pushing now.
jordan: i'll prepare the release note finalization and the rollback checklist in the runbook. ready to flip on your go, maria.
maria: holding until 02:58 UTC to observe. if no issues, flip at 03:05 UTC and I will post the release note update and deprecation email. if anything weird, we rollback to 1.4.2 and open a postmortem.
sam: ack.
anya: ack.
deploy-bot: dist-tag-flip scheduled at 03:05 UTC (pending confirmation from maria).
